db_host.description: Database server hostname or IP address

db_user.description: Database user with SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE permissions on Cacti DB

db_pass.description: Password for the database user (leave blank if no password required)

db_port.description: TCP port for database connection (0 uses default)

concurrency.description: Number of concurrent poller processes (0 = auto-detect based on CPU cores)

threads.description: Number of threads per poller process

log_path.description: Directory where Spine writes log files

ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 support for SNMP communication

snmp_opts.description: List of extra SNMP command-line options to apply globally (e.g., for SNMPv3)

items.description: Single space-separated option string (e.g., '-l authPriv -u myuser -a SHA -x AES')

php_path.description: Path to PHP CLI executable (required for some poller scripts)

snmpv3_enabled.description: Enable SNMPv3 support (automatically sets up v3 context if true)

mysql_lib.description: Full path to libmysqlclient.so (leave blank to use system default)
